question: As of October 2023, who among the following is the governor of Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raghubar Das**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Raghubar Das was appointed as the governor of Odisha in 2023.
 
• He is a senior politician from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• Raghubar Das has previously served as the Chief Minister of Jharkhand.
 
• He is known for his administrative skills and contributions to regional development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Governor of a State**

 
 
• The Governor is the constitutional head of a state in India.
 
• The Governor is appointed by the President of India.
 
• The Governor's role is largely ceremonial, but they have the power to summon, prorogue, or dissolve the state legislature.
 
• They also play a crucial role in the appointment of the Chief Minister and the Council of Ministers.
 
 
 
• **Raghubar Das**
 
 
• Raghubar Das is an Indian politician and a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He served as the 6th Chief Minister of Jharkhand from December 2014 to December 2019.
 
• He has been actively involved in politics for several decades and has held various significant positions within the party and government.
 
• His tenure as Chief Minister was marked by various developmental projects and reforms.
 
 
 
• **Odisha**
 
 
• Odisha is a state located in the eastern part of India.
 
• It is known for its rich cultural heritage, historical monuments, and natural beauty.
 
• Bhubaneswar is the capital city of Odisha, which is also known as the 'Temple City of India'.
 
• The state has a diverse economy with agriculture, mining, and tourism being the major sectors.
